zh: 除非你提前报名，否则不能参加这个活动。
old_en: You can't join the activity unless you sign up in advance.
new_en: You can't join the event unless you sign up in advance.

zh: 除非你早点出发，否则会迟到。
old_en: You'll be late unless you leave early.
new_en: You'll be late unless you leave early.

zh: 除非你现在就出发，否则会错过火车。
old_en: You'll miss the train unless you leave now.
new_en: You'll miss the train unless you leave now.

zh: 除非下雨，否则我们照常去公园。
old_en: We will go to the park as usual unless it rains.
new_en: We will go to the park as usual unless it rains.

zh: 除非有特殊情况，否则我们得按原计划行事。
old_en: We have to stick to the original plan unless there are special circumstances.
new_en: We have to follow the original plan unless there are special circumstances.

zh: 除非你现在就打电话，否则他可能不接。
old_en: He might not answer unless you call him now.
new_en: He might not answer unless you call him now.

zh: 除非你马上给他发信息，否则他可能不知道。
old_en: Unless you text him right away, he might not know.
new_en: Unless you text him right away, he might not know.

zh: 除非你提供购买凭证，否则不能退款。
old_en: Unless you provide proof of purchase, a refund isn't possible.
new_en: You can't get a refund unless you provide proof of purchase.

zh: 除非你提供收据，否则不能办理退货。
old_en: Unless you bring a receipt, you can't return the item.
new_en: You can't return the item unless you bring a receipt.

zh: 除非你提前一周取消，否则需要支付违约金。
old_en: Unless you cancel a week in advance, you'll have to pay a penalty.
new_en: Unless you cancel a week in advance, you'll have to pay a penalty fee.

zh: 除非你至少三天前通知，否则预订不可取消。
old_en: Unless you notify at least three days in advance, the reservation can't be canceled.
new_en: Reservations cannot be canceled unless you notify us at least three days in advance.

zh: 除非你带身份证，否则不能进入大楼。
old_en: Unless you bring your ID, you can't enter the building.
new_en: You cannot enter the building unless you bring your ID card.

zh: 除非你有学生证，否则不能进入实验室。
old_en: You can't enter the lab unless you have a student ID.
new_en: You cannot enter the lab unless you have a student ID.

zh: 除非下雨，否则我们去爬山。
old_en: We'll go climbing unless it rains.
new_en: We will go hiking unless it rains.

zh: 除非天气不好，否则我们照常举行野餐。
old_en: We'll have the picnic as usual unless the weather is bad.
new_en: We will hold the picnic as usual unless the weather is bad.

zh: 除非你提前告诉我，否则我不能帮你请假。
old_en: I can't ask for time off for you unless you tell me in advance.
new_en: I cannot ask for leave for you unless you tell me in advance.

zh: 除非你明天之前说，否则这次请假可能不行。
old_en: The leave request might not work unless you say something by tomorrow.
new_en: This leave request might not work unless you say something by tomorrow.

zh: 除非你按时到，否则我们没法开始。
old_en: We can't start unless you arrive on time.
new_en: We cannot start unless you arrive on time.

zh: 除非你能准时来，否则我们得改时间。
old_en: We'll have to change the time unless you can arrive on time.
new_en: We will have to change the time unless you can come on time.

zh: 除非你现在就打给他，否则明天就来不及了。
old_en: You'll miss him unless you call him now.
new_en: You will miss him unless you call him now.
